## Read and Clean

```{r}
sewage_cph <- readRDS("../data/processed/sewage_cph_mgnet.rds")
```

```{r}
plants_seasons_cph_common <- sewage_cph %>%
  filter_meta(collection_date >= as_date("2019-10-28")) %>%
  mutate_meta(
    season = case_when(
      collection_date >= as_date("2019-10-28") &
      collection_date <  as_date("2020-04-25") ~ "cold",
      
      collection_date >= as_date("2020-04-25") &
      collection_date <= as_date("2020-10-01") ~ "hot",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )) %>%
  split_meta(plant, season) %>%
  mutate_meta(sample_sum = sum(abun)) %>%
  filter_taxa(sum(abun >= 10) / n() >= .25) %>%
  group_mgnet(taxa_id) %>%
  filter_taxa(n() == length(.), .ungroup = T) %>%
  mutate_meta(lost_counts_common = 1 - (sum(abun) / sample_sum))

meta(plants_seasons_cph_common, .collapse = T) %>% pull(lost_counts_common) %>% summary
```

```{r}
plants_seasons_cph_common <- plants_seasons_cph_common %>%
  update_mgnet(norm = abun %>%
                 zCompositions::cmultRepl(method = "CZM",
                                          z.delete = F,
                                          z.warning = 1) %>%
                 vegan::decostand(method = "clr"))
```

## Diagnosis threshold value

```{r}
build_bonferroni_netw <- function(X, alpha = 0.05) {
  X <- as.matrix(X)

  cor_mat <- stats::cor(X, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  n_mat <- crossprod(!is.na(X))

  p_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = ncol(X), ncol = ncol(X), dimnames = dimnames(cor_mat))

  valid <- n_mat >= 3 & is.finite(cor_mat) & abs(cor_mat) < 1
  t_mat <- cor_mat * sqrt((n_mat - 2) / (1 - cor_mat^2))
  p_mat[valid] <- 2 * stats::pt(-abs(t_mat[valid]), df = n_mat[valid] - 2)

  p_mat[abs(cor_mat) == 1 & n_mat >= 3] <- 0
  diag(p_mat) <- 0

  upper_idx <- upper.tri(p_mat)
  p_adj <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = ncol(X), ncol = ncol(X), dimnames = dimnames(cor_mat))
  p_adj[upper_idx] <- stats::p.adjust(p_mat[upper_idx], method = "bonferroni")
  p_adj[lower.tri(p_adj)] <- t(p_adj)[lower.tri(p_adj)]
  diag(p_adj) <- 0

  netw <- cor_mat
  netw[is.na(p_adj) | p_adj >= alpha] <- 0
  diag(netw) <- 0
  netw <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(netw, mode = "undirected", weighted = T)
  
  netw
}
```


```{r}
assoc_list <- plants_seasons_cph_common %>%
  purrr::map(\(x) {
    
    cor_mat <- cor(norm(x))
    n <- nsample(x)
    
    res <- psych::corr.p(cor_mat, n = n, adjust = "bonferroni", ci = FALSE)
    p_bonf <- res$p
    p_bonf[lower.tri(p_bonf)] <- t(p_bonf)[lower.tri(p_bonf)]

  list(cor = cor_mat, p_bonf = p_bonf)
    
  })
```

```{r}
diagnosis_from_assoc <- function(assoc, thr) {
  
  mask <- assoc$p_bonf <= thr
  diag(mask) <- FALSE
  adj <- assoc$cor * mask
  
  g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
    adjmatrix = adj, mode = "undirected",
    weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE)
  
  deg <- degree(g)
  comp <- components(g)
  comp_sizes <- sort(comp$csize, decreasing = TRUE)
  n_edges <- gsize(g)
  
  tibble(
    threshold = thr,
    n_nodes = gorder(g),
    n_edges = n_edges,
    density = edge_density(g, loops = FALSE),
    avg_degree = mean(deg),
    frac_isolated = mean(deg == 0),
    n_components = comp$no,
    n_components_gt5 = sum(comp$csize > 5),
    lcc_size = max(comp$csize),
    lcc_fraction = max(comp$csize) / gorder(g),
    second_lcc_size = if (length(comp_sizes) >= 2) comp_sizes[2] else 0L,
    second_lcc_fraction = if (length(comp_sizes) >= 2) comp_sizes[2] / gorder(g) else 0,
    component_entropy = vegan::diversity(comp$csize),
    n_positive_edges = if (n_edges > 0) sum(E(g)$weight > 0) else 0L,
    n_negative_edges = if (n_edges > 0) sum(E(g)$weight < 0) else 0L,
    frac_positive = if (n_edges > 0) mean(E(g)$weight > 0) else NA_real_,
    frac_negative = if (n_edges > 0) mean(E(g)$weight < 0) else NA_real_,
    components_obj = list(comp)
  )
}
```

```{r}
cache_dir  <- "../cache"
cache_file <- file.path(cache_dir, "seasons_diagnosis.rds")

if (!dir.exists(cache_dir)) {
  dir.create(cache_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  message("Loading diagnostics from cache...")
  diag_tbl <- readRDS(cache_file)
} else {
  message("Cache not found. Computing diagnostics...")
  
  future::plan(future::multisession)
  
  thr_grid <- rev(10^seq(-8, log10(0.2), length.out = 50))
  
  diag_tbl <- purrr::imap_dfr(assoc_list, function(assoc, plant_season) {
    furrr::future_map_dfr(thr_grid, ~ diagnosis_from_assoc(assoc, .x)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(plant_season = plant_season, .before = 1)
  })
  
  future::plan(future::sequential)
  
  saveRDS(diag_tbl, cache_file)
  message("Diagnostics saved to: ", cache_file)
}

rm(cache_file, cache_dir)
```


```{r}
diag_plot_tbl <- diag_tbl %>%
  separate(plant_season, into = c("plant", "season"), sep = "-", remove = F) %>%
  select(
    plant_season, season, threshold,
    density, avg_degree, frac_isolated,
    lcc_size, second_lcc_size,
    n_components, n_components_gt5,
    component_entropy, n_edges) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(plant_season, season, threshold),
               names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = c(
        "density", "n_edges", "avg_degree", "frac_isolated", "lcc_size", "second_lcc_size",
        "n_components", "n_components_gt5", "component_entropy"),
      labels = c(
        "Density", "Number of edges", "Average degree", "Fraction isolated",
        "Largest connected component", "Second largest component",
        "Number of components", "Components > 5 nodes", "Component entropy")))

p_diag <- ggplot(diag_plot_tbl, aes(x = threshold, y = value,
                                    group = plant_season, color = plant_season)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, alpha = .5) +
  geom_point(size = 1.3, alpha = .75) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  #scale_x_reverse(labels = \(x) sprintf("%.01e", x)) +
  labs(
    x = "Absolute correlation threshold",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Plant") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
plants_seasons_cph_netw_filt <- plants_seasons_cph_common %>%
  group_mgnet(mgnet, comm_id) %>%
  filter_taxa(n() >= 20, .ungroup = T) 

names(plants_seasons_cph_netw_filt)
```

```{r}
common_cold <- plants_seasons_cph_netw_filt[c(1,2,3)] %>%
  taxa_id %>% reduce(intersect)

common_hot <- plants_seasons_cph_netw_filt[c(4,5,6)] %>%
  taxa_id %>% reduce(intersect)

common_taxa <- intersect(common_cold, common_hot)

plants_seasons_cph_netw_core <- plants_seasons_cph_netw_filt %>%
  mutate_taxa(
    taxa_type = case_when(
      taxa_id %in% common_taxa ~ "shared",
      taxa_id %in% common_hot ~ "hot",
      taxa_id %in% common_cold ~ "cold",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )) %>%
  #filter_taxa(!is.na(taxa_type))
  filter_taxa(taxa_id %in% common_taxa)
```

```{r}
signed_edge_jaccard <- function(g1, g2) {
  e1 <- igraph::as_data_frame(g1, what = "edges") %>%
    transmute(
      node1 = pmin(from, to),
      node2 = pmax(from, to),
      sign = if_else(weight >= 0, "pos", "neg"),
      edge_id = paste(node1, node2, sign, sep = "___")
    ) %>%
    pull(edge_id)
  
  e2 <- igraph::as_data_frame(g2, what = "edges") %>%
    transmute(
      node1 = pmin(from, to),
      node2 = pmax(from, to),
      sign = if_else(weight >= 0, "pos", "neg"),
      edge_id = paste(node1, node2, sign, sep = "___")
    ) %>%
    pull(edge_id)
  
  union_size <- length(union(e1, e2))
  if (union_size == 0) return(NA_real_)
  
  length(intersect(e1, e2)) / union_size
}

community_ari <- function(comm1, comm2) {
  memb1 <- membership(comm1)
  memb2 <- membership(comm2)
  
  nodes <- union(names(memb1), names(memb2))
  
  v1 <- setNames(rep(NA_integer_, length(nodes)), nodes)
  v2 <- setNames(rep(NA_integer_, length(nodes)), nodes)
  
  v1[names(memb1)] <- memb1
  v2[names(memb2)] <- memb2
  
  ok <- !is.na(v1) & !is.na(v2)
  if (sum(ok) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  
  mclust::adjustedRandIndex(v1[ok], v2[ok])
}


degree_correlation <- function(g1, g2, method = "pearson") {
  nodes <- union(V(g1)$name, V(g2)$name)
  
  d1 <- setNames(rep(0, length(nodes)), nodes)
  d2 <- setNames(rep(0, length(nodes)), nodes)
  
  d1[V(g1)$name] <- degree(g1)
  d2[V(g2)$name] <- degree(g2)
  
  cor(d1, d2, method = method)
}
```


```{r}
network_meta <- tibble(net_name = names(plants_seasons_cph_netw_core)) %>%
  separate(net_name, into = c("plant", "season"), sep = "-", remove = FALSE)


test <- plants_seasons_cph_netw_core %>%
  filter_taxa(taxa_id %in% common_taxa)
graph_list <- netw(test)
comm_list <- comm(test)

levels_sort <- c("Avedoere-cold", "Damhusaaen-cold", "Lynetten-cold",
                 "Avedoere-hot", "Damhusaaen-hot", "Lynetten-hot")

pairwise_tbl <- tidyr::crossing(
  net1 = network_meta$net_name,
  net2 = network_meta$net_name) %>%
  filter(net1 < net2) %>%
  left_join(network_meta, by = c("net1" = "net_name")) %>%
  rename(plant1 = plant, season1 = season) %>%
  left_join(network_meta, by = c("net2" = "net_name")) %>%
  rename(plant2 = plant, season2 = season) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison_group = case_when(
      season1 == "hot"  & season2 == "hot"  & plant1 != plant2 ~ "hot-hot across sites",
      season1 == "cold" & season2 == "cold" & plant1 != plant2 ~ "cold-cold across sites",
      plant1 == plant2 & season1 != season2 ~ "same site, different season",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    )) %>%
  filter(comparison_group != "other") %>%
  mutate(
    edge_jaccard = map2_dbl(net1, net2, \(x, y) signed_edge_jaccard(graph_list[[x]],
                                                                    graph_list[[y]])),
    degree_cor = map2_dbl(net1, net2, \(x, y) degree_correlation(graph_list[[x]],
                                                                 graph_list[[y]])),
    community_ari = map2_dbl(net1, net2, \(x, y) community_ari(comm_list[[x]], 
                                                               comm_list[[y]]))) %>%
  mutate(net1 = factor(net1, levels = levels_sort)) %>%
  mutate(comparison_group = factor(comparison_group, 
                                   levels = c("cold-cold across sites",
                                              "hot-hot across sites",
                                              "same site, different season")),
    site_pair = paste(pmin(plant1, plant2), pmax(plant1, plant2), sep = " – "),
    season_label = case_when(
      comparison_group == "cold-cold across sites" ~ "cold",
      comparison_group == "hot-hot across sites" ~ "hot",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    season_label = factor(season_label, levels = c("cold", "hot")))
```

```{r}
pairwise_long <- pairwise_tbl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(edge_jaccard, degree_cor, community_ari),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = c("edge_jaccard", "degree_cor", "community_ari"),
      labels = c("Signed edge Jaccard", "Degree correlation", "Community ARI")
    )
  )
```

## Networks with same layout COLD

```{r}
cold_core <- plants_seasons_cph_netw_core[c(1,2,3)] %>%
  mutate_link(link_name = paste(pmin(from, to), pmax(from,to), sep = "---")) %>%
  group_link(link_name) %>%
  mutate_link(missing_lynetten =
                any(mgnet == "Avedoere-cold") &
                any(mgnet == "Damhusaaen-cold") &
                !any(mgnet == "Lynetten-cold"))

missing_tbl <- cold_core %>%
  link(.fmt = "tbl") %>%
  group_by(link_name) %>%
  summarise(
    missing_lynetten = any(missing_lynetten),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r}
cold_consensus <- mgnet(
  taxa = select(taxa(plants_seasons_cph_netw_core$`Damhusaaen-cold`), -comm_id),
  netw =  netw(cold_core) %>%
    map(\(x) sign(as_adjacency_matrix(x, sparse = F))) %>% 
    reduce(`+`) %>%
    graph_from_adjacency_matrix(mode = "undirected", weighted = T)) %>%
  update_mgnet(comm = netkit::cluster_signed_louvain(netw)) %>%
  group_mgnet(comm_id) %>%
  mutate_netw(eig_comm = eigen_centrality(netw)$vector,
              deg_comm = degree(netw)) %>%
  mutate_taxa(node_label = if_else(row_number(desc(eig_comm)) <= 1,
                                   taxa_id, NA), .ungroup = T) %>%
  mutate_link(consensus = factor(weight, levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                                 labels = c("1 site", "2 sites", "3 sites")),
              link_name = paste(pmin(from, to), pmax(from,to), sep = "---")) %>%
  mutate_taxa(family_label = replace_na(family, "Unknown"),
              family_label = fct_lump_min(family_label, 5),
              family_label = fct_relevel(family_label, "Other", "Unknown", after = Inf)) 
```

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=15, warning=FALSE}

lay_consensus <- netkit::layout_signed(netw(cold_consensus),

p_A <- to_tbl_graph(cold_consensus) %>%
```
